name: Infection Inc. 2
desc:
DISCLAIMER: I scripted and conceptualized the original game, then my builder and I had a falling out, hence why I created the second game on my own.

Welcome to Infection Inc. 2!!! Back and better than ever! Create your zombie army and take over the world!!! Rebirths increase your zombies speed and HP by 10%. Rebirths are capped at 11 so you cant destroy a server with your op zombies. 
Be sure to 👍 and ⭐ if you enjoyed the game.

You must rejoin the game to get your group perks!

Please Note: I haven't taken the game out of the Christmas state because I personally think the game looks a lot better with the snow and I plan to permanently leave it as such.

Follow my twitter home slice 
@realT0XZ
